document.title: PP 9/2026: THR dan gaji ketiga belas ASN dan pensiunan 2026

delta.note: PP 9/2026 regulates the 2026 THR and 13th salary for state apparatus (civil servants, PPPK, TNI, Polri, state officials, non-ASN government employees), pensioners, and benefit recipients. It concerns civil servants and pensioners, who are outside the scope of permanent private-sector employees. Its only tax provision states that income tax is imposed under the prevailing rules and borne by the Government (DTP) for these state recipients. It does not change PPh 21 rates, tables, deductions or calculation steps for permanent employees (pegawai tetap) in general.
